[*] New ITEMS! Black smudgy eyeliner, black eyeshadow, pink eyeshadow, black lipstick, & pale pink lip gloss!

[img]https://slasheru.neocities.org/5RKQY0_tiny.png[/img]
New build (v6.0018), including some extra Tate inroads and UI feedback changes! Thanks to everyone on the Discord for popping in with your accessability suggestions - love y'all Student Disembody!

MAJOR CHANGES
[list]
[*] You can now tell Tate you love him if you’re his partner. I know, right?
[*] You can now turn Autosaves on and off in the Settings! The game will Autosave into slot Data 1 every time you move to a new room/map if you turn on that setting!
[*] Added some Sawyer room key text into the censored stuff for Streamer Mode!
[*] Added extra UI feedback when you do something EXTRA nice or EXTRA shitty to someone
[*] [TENTATIVE] Fixed it so the food order book no longer disappears at seemingly random occasions
[*] [TENTATIVE] Hex’s hookup overlay SHOULD no longer linger in the morning… I’m having a bit of trouble hunting this one down, so lmk!
[/list]

MINOR CHANGES
[list]
[*] You can no longer use lampposts to walk through walls. Sorry, spelunkers!
[*] Cleaned up locks for Partner Chat for everyone so you don’t see the locks for Act 2 content in Act 1
[/list]

As always, you can report bugs on the #bugs-bugs-bugs channel on Discord! <3333
